summary: Heroes now cast their spells in slot order. Some monsters, spells and crafter experience have a balance pass. Dungeons give bonus materials.

highlights.title: Spell order
highlights.text: Heroes cast spells 1, 2 and 3, then the Ultimate. One basic attack follows each spell.

highlights.title: Boss and drops
highlights.text: The Goblin Chief has 1,800 HP. Dungeons now give bonus materials.

groups.heading: Battle and spells
items: Heroes cast in slot order 1, 2, 3, then the Ultimate, with one basic attack after each spell. A spell that is not ready is skipped. Monsters are unchanged.
Shield Bash adds 160%, 175% and 190% of Defence. Power Strike II, Aimed Shot II and Fire Bolt II do 195%, and rank III does 210%. Frost Shard does 160%, 175% and 190%.

groups.heading: Monsters and drops
items: Goblin Chief has 1,800 HP and attacks every 1.5 seconds. The Hobgoblin factor is 0.83. The Bark Spider factor is 0.90.
Quartz is a rare drop from the Wolf Trail on. It never takes the guaranteed drop.
No monster drops Faint Essence or Tarnished Catalyst.

groups.heading: Dungeon bonus drops
items: From the Wolf Trail on, each won fight has a 15% chance to give 1 basic material (Copper Ore, Pine Wood, Rawhide or Linen). The dungeon screen shows it.

groups.heading: Crafting
items: Crafter experience from level 4 is 7% to 17% lower.

groups.heading: Other
items: The Goblin Chief's Lair has a new backdrop with a goblin throne and banners.
The game has app icons and a web manifest. The tab title and install name follow the game language.
Castle tales are split into pages. Layout fixes for modals, the backpack, the run report and the story pager.
